newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Bovespa index to be shortened Mon.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Bovespa index to be shortened Mon.

text.p: Sao Paulo bourse's Bovespa index will be one digit shorter as of Monday to make it easier for investors and traders to follow the index, the stock exchange said in a statement.
The Bovespa index will be divided by 10 as it is close to reaching six digits, it said.
The index, which is made up of the 49 most traded stocks on the Sao Paulo bolsa, was created on January 2, 1968. The last adjustment in the Bovespa index occurred in February 1994.
Futures index contracts and index options, which are based on the index, will also be affected.
On Thursday, the Bovespa index closed at 87,768 points.
